name: flam-study-assistant
description: AI study assistant: paste notes or a topic, get flashcards and a quiz you can actually use.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('server/.env')) fs.copyFileSync('server/.env.example','server/.env')"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
